snippet.title: Stuntman: Hollywood - Knightrider Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Lights, camera, crash. Saber Interactive's Stuntman: Hollywood is a new single-player action racing game in the Stuntman series, made with Universal Products & Experiences for PS5, Xbox Series and PC. You play a stunt driver chaining jumps, drifts and near-misses through set pieces inspired by Fast & Furious, Back to the Future, Knight Rider, Miami Vice and Death Race, behind the wheel of icons like K.I.T.T. and the Time Machine. Every take counts, so hit your marks and become Hollywood's most wanted stunt performer.
